hero.description: Cream-Off is a pet healthcare platform centered around ‘Talktail’, a wearable device ‘Tailing’, and an AI skin diagnostic solution, setting a new standard in health care.

intro.title: Intro
intro.intro_title: Cream-Off provides wearable devices 'Tailing' and AI-based skin diagnosis solutions through the pet healthcare brand 'Talktail', creating technology that removes complexity from everyday life and leaves only the essentials.

vision.value2: Cream-Off is a technology company that removes the unnecessary from the digital world, leaving only the essential value.

core_values.value3: We create new standards with a balance of technology and design.
core_values.value4: We provide solutions that reduce complexity and increase efficiency.

service.title: Solutions
service.description: Cream-Off is setting new standards in health care through the pet healthcare platform ‘Talktail’, wearable device ‘Tailing’, and AI skin diagnosis solutions.

wearable.title: Pet Wearable Device
wearable.name: Talktail
wearable.description: Tailing is a Talktail exclusive wearable device that measures pet vital data in real-time. It is a B2B-focused medical assistant device that increases both diagnostic accuracy and owner trust.

heart_rate.text: Detects abnormal signs and alerts (real-time monitoring of temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, etc.)

notification.text: Hospital dashboard integration (automated treatment and customized notifications)

ai_diagnosis.title: Pet Skin Disease AI Diagnosis
ai_diagnosis.name: Talktail Skincare AI
ai_diagnosis.description: Talktail Skincare AI diagnoses pet skin with just one photo, predicts disease possibility through AI, and links to hospitals for non-face-to-face care solutions.

analysis.text: Image-based skin analysis (disease classification and prediction through deep learning)

upload.text: Easy image upload (diagnosis requests via app/web)

hospital.text: Hospital connection system (direct connection to the most suitable hospital)
